boundary: Dynamic basic-block application instruction estimate, including libraries. REP-string and asynchronous interruption accounting differs from other tools. Calibration covers straight-line loops, not all x86 or hardware semantics. This is not an official Arena instruction score.
reason: The 24-byte node uses 6.961% more dynamic instructions on the fixed prefix; it is not promoted for the instruction-count objective. Whole-workload memory effect is unmeasured.
